::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Bengaluru firm founded 2018 by Mohan Jindal (ex-Intel); iDEX DISC1 winner with about ₹8.2 crore in government grants. Its ABHED-1 encryptor and Data Diode are FPGA/custom-circuit appliances supplied to Indian defence; no ASIC tape-out of its own is reported.
:::

## What does this firm design?

Hardware-only network encryption appliances (ABHED-1, Data Diode) and ASIC front-end design/verification services.
